questions.prompt: Which shape has 4 equal sides and 4 square corners?
questions.explanation: A square has 4 equal sides and 4 square corners. A rectangle has square corners, but its sides are not all equal.

questions.prompt: An even number can be shared into 2 equal groups with none left over.
questions.explanation: Even numbers like 8 make 2 groups of 4.

questions.prompt: A bike ride took 1 hour and 55 minutes. About how many hours is that? Type a number.
questions.explanation: 55 minutes is almost a whole hour, so the ride took about 2 hours.
